data.name: OpenAI: GPT-4o
data.description:
GPT-4o ("o" for "omni") is OpenAI's latest AI model, supporting both text and image inputs with text outputs.

It maintains the intelligence level of GPT-4 Turbo while being twice as fast.

data.name: DeepSeek: R1
data.description: DeepSeek R1 is here: performance on par with OpenAI o1, but open-sourced and with fully open reasoning tokens.  It's 671B parameters in size, with 37B active in an inference pass.
